note: Provincial-park campground in aspen, ash and birch woods beside Pike Lake, an oxbow of the South Saskatchewan River about 20 minutes south of Saskatoon; three loops (A, B, C), with 24 seasonal sites in C. Heated outdoor pool, waterslide and beach. --Claude
summary: Keep. 219 campsites (185 nightly electric, 10 short non-electric, 24 seasonal), 15/30 A, no water/sewer hookups, rigs to 50 ft, site-specific booking on SKPP; winter camping in loop A to Mar 14. Not waterfront confirmed; pin sits on loop A, no move. Phone '' -> 1-306-933-6966.
flags: SITES: stored count 222 (note prose) -> 219 (68 A + 73 B electric + 10 B non-electric + 44 C nightly + 24 C seasonal; yurt, groups, pavilion, shelter excluded). Stored note said 'all but 11 with 30-amp': there are 10 non-electric sites (211-220), all 20 ft, too short for a 23-ft rig.
HOOKUPS: electric 30 confirmed (15/30 on every electric site). Water/sewer written false: 'Full Hookup - no' on every row.

SEASON: stored 05-01..09-30 (derived, 'approximate') -> wrap-around 05-14..03-14 (2026-27): full season May 14 - Sep 30, fall camping Sep-Oct by phone, winter camping in loop A Nov 1, 2026 - Mar 14, 2027 with reduced services. Same treatment as Good Spirit Lake (9177).

WATERFRONT: 'not waterfront' confirmed. Every site row reads 'Near Water - no'. The lake (oxbow) lies NE of loop A: nearest sites A1/A5/A6 (about 51.8878,-106.8115) are ~170 m from it behind forest and the day-use area. The narrow channel east of loop C is ~20-35 m wide and ~40-60 m from C148-C151 (51.8853,-106.8078) behind a treed strip.

PIN: no move. Stored 51.886,-106.811 sits on loop A (A centroid 51.88602,-106.81135); B centroid 51.88303,-106.81037, C 51.88419,-106.80810. (The park GPS 51.8923,-106.8178 on the SKPP page is ~850 m away at the park entrance/day use.)
